reason: 'Shrubs or small trees, to 8 m tall': whole-plant height, maximum 8 m, no minimum. Matches the flora.

fix: In plant descriptions 'compressed' (of achenes, stems, fruits) means flattened. It does not mean PATO 'condensed' (packed tighter), even though the PATO lexicon lists 'compressed' as a synonym of condensed. Map 'compressed' to flattened PATO_0002254 (or laterally compressed PATO_0002054 when stated). The 'of ray florets' restriction should also be recorded: disk-floret achenes are described separately.
reason: The achenes are ± flat. PATO_0001485 'condensed' is the wrong sense.
The male inflorescence is branched (about 3 times), and the male context is recorded (PATO_0000384). The branching order is dropped, but nothing false is said.
'Not climbing' in the habit field: climbing (FLOPO_0991108) on the whole plant, negated. Matches the flora.

fix: 'Lowest X ...' at the start of a relational statement should fill the position slot with lower (FLOPO_0991377), as it already does for measurements. Without it, every bract is said to overtop the inflorescence.
reason: Only the lowest bracts overtop the inflorescence (and only frequently). The upper bracts do not.
Stamens shorter than petals: decreased length relative to petal. Matches the flora.
Stems (0.6-)1-2(-2.8) dm becomes 10-20 cm, with extremes 6 and 28 cm. The conversion is right, and in FNA stem length stands for plant height.

target: apex of the leaf auricle (auricle of the leaf sheath, a FLOPO anatomy class if one exists; otherwise reject)
fix: In a 'Leaves:' paragraph, 'apex' after a sub-part ('auricles ..., apex acutish') belongs to that sub-part, not to the leaf. Attach it to the nearest named part before it.
reason: 'acutish' describes the apex of the auricles, not the leaf. The quality (subacute) is right.

fix: 'Female flowers' / 'Male flowers' at the start of a count should fill the state slot (female PATO_0000383 / male PATO_0000384). The context word list already covers 'female' + 'flower', but it was not applied here.
reason: Ottelia has 1 female flower per spathe, but male flowers are usually several per spathe. Without 'female' the count is false.
The lowest lemma is 4.8-6 mm, with position lower (FLOPO_0991377) recorded. The upper lemmas are much shorter, so the position slot matters, and it is there.

fix: 'ray-flowers' / 'ray florets' should map to ray flower PO_0025331, not plain flower. The count 'numerous' also leaves out the capitulum as the whole they are counted in.
reason: The flora says ray flowers are numerous. Disk flowers are a separate class, and a generic 'many flowers' loses the distinction.

fix: In 'the outermost 3-5 small, unequal', the adjectives after 'the outermost N' belong to that subset. Fill the position slot with outer (FLOPO_0991379).
reason: Only the outermost 3-5 perianth segments are small and unequal. The inner 5-8 are described separately.

target: primary leaf divisions / leaflets (PO_0019035 leaflet or a FLOPO division class)
fix: 'simply ternate, then pinnate or bipinnate' describes successive orders of division: the leaf is ternate and each primary division is pinnate or bipinnate. 'then' after a division word should move the next values to the divisions, not the leaf. The leaf itself is ternate(-pinnate).
reason: The whole leaf is not pinnate. Its three primary divisions are pinnate or bipinnate.
'needlelike' maps to subulate through the PATO synonym 'needle-like'. Strictly, needle-like is acicular, a little narrower than awl-shaped, but no closer term exists and the annotation is acceptable.
The stems are thinly pubescent. The degree word 'thinly' is dropped, but the annotation is true.

fix: Shape words after 'acumen', 'apex', 'tip' or 'base' belong to that part of the leaf, not the whole leaf. Here the leaf is oblong-ovate and narrowed to an acumen that is narrowly obtuse or bluntly acute.
reason: 'narrowly obtuse or bluntly acute' describes the acumen (leaf apex). The whole leaf is not obtuse.

fix: '(5–) many per N': the bracketed number is a rare lower extreme and 'many' is the usual value. Record min_extreme 5 with an open or 'many' upper value, not 5-5.
reason: The flora says usually many spikelets per head and at least 5. The annotation says exactly 5.
The leaf blade is narrowly obovate to spathulate, recorded as obovate-to-spatulate on the leaf lamina. Matches the flora.
'Racèmes ... multiflores': many flowers, counted per inflorescence. Matches the flora.
'Capitula numerous': capitula present, many. Matches the flora.
'very short hairs': trichome with decreased length. Matches the flora.

target: distal position on the calyx tube
fix: A position adverb ('distally', 'apically', 'basally') before a shape word limits the shape to that region. It should fill the position slot, or the bearer should be the region.
reason: Only the distal part of the calyx tube is cup-shaped. In Terminalia the lower part is narrow around the ovary. Saying the whole calyx is cupulate overstates it.
Calyx teeth about 2 mm: sepal (calyx lobe) length 2 mm. The 'ca.' qualifier is lost, but the value is right.

target: base of the calyx (part of PO_0009060)
fix: 'base truncate to rounded' after an organ describes the shape of the base, not the whole organ. Attach it to the base or apex region (as is done for leaf apex and leaf base). Also, 'rounded' maps better to a rounded value than to obtuse PATO_0001935, whose definition is 'roundish, a little inclining to be oblong'.
reason: The calyx is ovate-oblong. Only its base is truncate to somewhat rounded.

fix: 'inner phyllaries' / 'outer phyllaries' should fill the position slot. The context word 'inner' lists 'phyllar' but was not applied, maybe because 'phyllaries' was mapped to bract first.
reason: Only the inner phyllaries are ovate-lanceolate. The outer ones are lanceolate-oblong.
The primary bracts are shorter than the spikes: decreased length relative to the spike. 'primary' is not recorded, but this is the only kind of bract described here.
Pedicel length 2-3 mm. Matches the flora.
A pulpy pericarp means a fleshy fruit (drupe). Putting it on the fruit instead of the pericarp (PO_0009084) is acceptable, because fleshiness of a fruit is fleshiness of its pericarp.
Calyx lobes ovate to subrectangular: sepal 2-D shape, ovate to subrectangular. Matches the flora.
Petals with purplish red spots: petal spotted. Matches the flora.
